breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero by symmetry, but for a simply supported beam under a midspan point load the slope is zero at midspan, not at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated that slope vanishes at both supports and at midspan. The generated specification correctly removes this erroneous claim and instead properly applies the boundary condition v'(L/2) = 0 (zero slope at midspan by symmetry), while correctly identifying that the slope at the supports is nonzero and needs to be computed. This aligns with the ground truth prompt, which simply asks to compute the slope at the supports without imposing any incorrect zero-slope condition there.
